case_number: 2025 INSC 350; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO……………2025 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.3154 of 2024)
summary: Successive FIRs vs public servant; mandatory FIR registration under CrPC s.154; preliminary inquiry only in limited cases (e.g., medical negligence, family disputes); Lalita Kumari affirmed; no pre-FIR hearing right; abuse of process claim rejected; reliefs: anticipatory bail, malicious prosecution remedies sufficient; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Lalita Kumari v. Government of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding FIR registrations affirmed.
